title: [Screen Ruler] Add haptic feedback for detected measurement edges

status.label: Owned Screen Ruler haptics tracker
status.detail: This labeled and assigned Screen Ruler tracker is part of #48761 and depends on #50162, while #50166 still requires canonicalization.

next_action.label: Post stable-edge scope note
next_action.reason: The implementation must suppress noisy detections and coordinate with the duplicate-looking #50166 tracker.

comment.body: This assigned Screen Ruler tracker should consume #50162 for parent #48761. Please trigger Hover only when a newly detected edge has a stable identity, with duplicate suppression, spatial hysteresis, and a minimum interval so stationary or transient detections do not buzz. Also confirm the relationship to open issue #50166, which currently has the same title and scope, before implementation discussion splits.

judgment.rationale: This is a maintainer-authored, assigned and labeled implementation tracker, but coordination with the equivalent open #50166 is still necessary.
evidence: The issue is authored and assigned to niels9001 and labeled Product-Screen Ruler.
It references parent #48761 and shared infrastructure #50162.
The body defines stable-edge identity, duplicate suppression, spatial hysteresis, and interval requirements.
Open issue #50166 has the same title and near-identical scope.
judgment.recommended_action: Post a scope and coordination note preserving stable-edge semantics while requiring canonicalization with #50166.
